newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in london end higher, await survey.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in london end higher, await survey.

text.p: Japanese stocks were cautiously higher in London on Friday as market sentiment improved and investors waited for a Bank of Japan business sentiment survey next week, dealers said.
The Nikkei 50 index of leading Japanese shares in London was up 5.04 points or 0.35 percent at 1,460.62 by 1354 GMT. The Nikkei 225 in Tokyo rose 72.77 points or 0.34 percent to finish at 21,216.11.
"To be honest, nothing much is going on at the moment except the market is a little bit firmer and the sentiment is better," said one dealer.
Dealers said the market was waiting for the "tankan" survey by the Bank of Japan on Wednesday, which would give a signal on the strength of the current economic recovery.
"I don't think we are going to miss anything in the next few hours and I think that most people have shut down for the rest of the day," said another dealer.
